proves.claim: With next.returnedFirst on, runCommand for next, claim, submit, show and fact says one line per returned rejection of the calling seat before the command's own lines, and none once a seat has claimed the item.

cli.io-cli-main-run-command.rejection-ec.why: Without it a builder whose work was sent back would not see the reason until it ran show by hand.

proves.claim: With next.returnedFirst off or unset, and for every other command, runCommand says exactly the lines it said before the echo.

cli.io-cli-main-run-command.rejection-ec.why: Without it the echo would change every seat's output with the setting off.
